title: Diagonal adjunction for the explicit finite projective-line counit
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring killed by $N>0$, and let $t,d$ be normalized finite-line comparisons and projective-line splittings satisfying the splitting-and-trace base-change property [lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals]. Let $q:X\to Y$ be a proper compactifiable morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-asd-compactifiable] with an isomorphism $e:X\cong\mathbf P^1_Y$ over $Y$ and $N$ invertible on $Y$. Suppose the supported diagonal on $\mathbf P^1_Y\times_Y\mathbf P^1_Y$ has both normalized integrals one, in the sense of the finite diagonal property of [lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals]. Then $Rq_!$ is left adjoint to $q^*(-)\otimes_A^L A_X(1)[2]$ on the entire ordinary unbounded etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with actual counit equal to the constructed map $\varepsilon_q$ [def-asd-presented-projective-line-trace-model]. This assertion involves one base and no exceptional base-change map.

source.place: Both diagonal triangle calculations and the actual inverse-projection counit.

proof.text: Use the explicit transported kernel adjunction. Its proved construction chooses the supported class from the diagonal property, conjugates the ordinary integral identities to compact-support identities and applies the existing lisse-line triangle theorem. In particular the trace field remains the constructed SfP1Transport.trace.

Apply coefficient normalization to obtain an automorphism of the shifted line relating the transported trace to proper coincidence followed by the prescribed presentation trace. Replace only the trace field of the kernel datum by this normalized composite; projection naturality gives the corresponding change formula for its kernel counit.

Transport the right adjoint first by the inverse tensor action of that automorphism and then by tensor symmetry. The formula for Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight gives the counit component as direct image of the inverse symmetry, followed by direct image of the tensor action, followed by the old kernel counit. Substitute the proved change formula.

Apply the proper kernel-versus-ordered-projection counit comparison to the adjusted datum. Equality of every component gives equality of natural transformations with the prescribed finite counit. A private canonical-compactification proof and proof irrelevance preserve the original explicit HasCompactification binder in the public theorem.

proof_origin.place: The two diagonal triangle calculations, explicit transport across the presentation, and the actual inverse-projection counit.

theorem exists_presentedFiniteP1TraceAdjunction
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (d : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1Splitting A N hA t T hT)
    (hbc : ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t d)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper q] [HasCompactification q]
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine Y) (w : e.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) = q)
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (hdiag : finiteP1DiagonalProperty A N hA t d Y hY) :
    ∃ adj : R(q)_![ModuleCat.{u + 1} A] ⊣
        ordinaryFiniteTwistedPullback A q ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA X)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧),
      adj.counit = presentedFiniteP1Counit A N hA t q e w hY (d Y hY)
